You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value, sometimes a condition, and the place it comes from.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the facts, step by step: a repeal or a
  limit "from 20 January" does not yet apply on 16 January.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the facts.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- Return JSON only:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: How often must the wear indicator of the load nut of the MA STAR 3.5 A vehicle lift be checked?

Facts:
[0] 4.3.3 lifting machinery, maximum working load — requiresMeasure — prominently marked (prominently marked) [REG, Annex III, 4.3.3]
[1] lifting machinery maximum working load — requiresMeasure — prominently marked (prominently marked) [DIR, Annex I, 4.3.3]
[2] loading control 4.2.2 — requiresMeasure — devices to warn the driver and prevent dangerous movements (devices to warn the driver and prevent dangerous movements) [condition: with a maximum working load of not less than 1 000 kg or an overturning moment of not less than 40 000 Nm] [REG, Annex III, 4.2.2]
[3] 4.3.3 machinery with configuration-dependent working load — requiresMeasure — load plate (load plate) [condition: Where the maximum working load depends on the configuration of the lifting machinery or related product] [REG, Annex III, 4.3.3]
[4] internal parts requiring frequent inspection and adjustment, and maintenance areas — requiresMeasure — appropriate lighting (appropriate lighting) [DIR, Annex I, 1.1.4]
[5] loading control — requiresMeasure — fitted with devices to warn the driver and prevent dangerous movements (fitted with devices to warn the driver and prevent dangerous movements) [condition: Machinery with a maximum working load of not less than 1 000 kilograms or an overturning moment of not less than 40 000 Nm] [DIR, Annex I, 4.2.2]
[6] lifting machinery working load per configuration — requiresMeasure — load plate (load plate) [condition: Where the maximum working load depends on the configuration of the machinery] [DIR, Annex I, 4.3.3]
[7] internal parts and maintenance areas — requiresMeasure — appropriate lighting (appropriate lighting) [condition: Internal parts requiring frequent inspection and adjustment, and maintenance areas] [REG, Annex III, 1.1.4]
[8] lifting machinery — mustAccompany — a copy of the load plate or load table (a copy of the load plate or load table) [condition: where appropriate] [REG, Annex III, 4.4.2]
[9] vehicle servicing lifts — listedIn — Vehicle servicing lifts (vehicle servicing lifts) [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 3]
[10] lifting machinery — mustAccompany — a test report (a test report) [condition: where appropriate] [REG, Annex III, 4.4.2]
[11] lifting machinery — mustAccompany — a test report detailing the static and dynamic tests (test report on static and dynamic tests) [condition: where appropriate] [DIR, Annex I, 4.4.2]
[12] regular inspection of machinery or related product — verifiedBy — designated bodies (designated bodies) [condition: may be subject to national requirements for regular inspection] [REG, Annex III, 2.4.10]
[13] vehicle servicing lifts — listedIn — Vehicle servicing lifts (annex IV point 16) [DIR, Annex IV]
[14] machinery subject to tow bar load — requiresMeasure — a support with a bearing surface (a support with a bearing surface) [condition: Insofar as the tow bar load so requires] [REG, Annex III, 3.4.6]
[15] machine part mass — hasObligation — its mass must be indicated (its mass must be indicated) [condition: where a machine part must be handled during use with lifting equipment] [DIR, Annex I, 1.7.3]
[16] adjustment and maintenance points — requiresMeasure — located outside danger zones (located outside danger zones) [REG, Annex III, 1.6.1]
[17] lifting machinery marking — requiresMeasure — legible, indelible and in an un-coded form (legible, indelible and in an un-coded form) [DIR, Annex I, 4.3.3]
[18] essential requirement 2.4.6.2 — requiresMeasure — designed and constructed to facilitate the changing of worn parts (designed and constructed to facilitate the changing of worn parts) [condition: without contamination of the environment] [REG, Annex III, 2.4.6.2]
[19] Static test — definedAs — the test during which lifting machinery or a lifting accessory is first inspected (the test during which lifting machinery or a lifting accessory is first inspected) [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.1]
[20] warning and signalling devices — requiresMeasure — the means to check that they are in good working order (the means to check that they are in good working order) [condition: where it is essential for safety] [REG, Annex III, 3.6.1]
[21] machinery with a tow bar load — requiresMeasure — a support with a bearing surface (a support with a bearing surface) [condition: Insofar as the tow bar load so requires] [DIR, Annex I, 3.4.6]
[22] adjustment and maintenance points — requiresMeasure — must be located outside danger zones (must be located outside danger zones) [DIR, Annex I, 1.6.1]
[23] machinery or related products — requiresMeasure — fitted with indicators (fitted with indicators) [condition: as required for safe operation] [REG, Annex III, 1.2.2]
[24] full reassessment — hasTimeLimit — every three years (P3Y) [DIR, Annex X]
[25] 4.3.3 lifting goods-only machinery with carrier allowing access to persons — requiresMeasure — clear and indelible warning prohibiting the lifting of persons (clear and indelible warning prohibiting the lifting of persons) [condition: Machinery or related products intended for lifting goods only, equipped with a carrier, which allows access to persons] [REG, Annex III, 4.3.3]
[26] machinery and lifting accessories — addressesRisk — failure from fatigue and wear (failure from fatigue and wear) [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.3]
[27] datore di lavoro, controllo dopo ogni montaggio — hasObligation — dopo ogni montaggio in un nuovo cantiere o in una nuova località di impianto (dopo ogni montaggio in un nuovo cantiere o in una nuova località di impianto) [condition: attrezzature di lavoro la cui sicurezza dipende dalle condizioni di installazione] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 8]
[28] driver checking devices that exceed the normal clearance zone — requiresMeasure — the means of checking easily (the means of checking easily) [condition: where machinery is fitted with devices which exceed its normal clearance zone] [REG, Annex III, 3.3.2]
[29] lifting machinery — mustAccompany — contents of the logbook (contents of the logbook) [condition: if the latter is not supplied with the lifting machinery] [REG, Annex III, 4.4.2]
[30] adjustment, maintenance, repair, cleaning and servicing operations — requiresMeasure — at a standstill (at a standstill) [condition: while the machinery or related product is at a standstill] [REG, Annex III, 1.6.1]
[31] machinery with material fed automatically to tool — requiresMeasure — the latter shall have attained its normal working condition (the tool shall have attained its normal working condition) [condition: when the work piece comes into contact with the tool] [REG, Annex III, 1.3.2]
[32] operator — hasObligation — have facilities to check the operation of such warning devices at all times (have facilities to check the operation of such warning devices at all times) [REG, Annex III, 1.7.1.2]
[33] warning prohibiting lifting of persons — requiresMeasure — visible (visible) [condition: where access is possible] [DIR, Annex I, 4.3.3]
[34] 2.3(c) machinery — requiresMeasure — automatic brake (automatic brake) [condition: if there is a risk of contact with the tool whilst it runs down] [DIR, Annex I, 2.3]
[35] lifting accessories — mustAccompany — instructions setting out at least the following particulars (instructions setting out at least the following particulars) [condition: each lifting accessory or each commercially indivisible batch of lifting accessories] [REG, Annex III, 4.4.1]
[36] adjustment, maintenance, repair, cleaning and servicing operations — requiresMeasure — measures must be taken (measures must be taken) [condition: If one or more of the above conditions cannot be satisfied for technical reasons] [DIR, Annex I, 1.6.1]
[37] manufacturer or authorised representative — hasObligation — must ensure (must ensure) [condition: When lifting machinery or lifting accessories are placed on the market or are first put into service] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.3]
[38] lifting machinery or related products — mustAccompany — instructions for use (instructions for use) [REG, Annex III, 4.4.2]
[39] signs on the machinery — requiresMeasure — legible at a sufficient distance (legible at a sufficient distance) [DIR, Annex I, 3.6.1]
[40] seat mountings — requiresMeasure — withstand all stresses (withstand all stresses to which they can be subjected) [REG, Annex III, 1.1.8]
[41] loading control 4.2.2 — addressesRisk — overturning moment being exceeded (overturning moment being exceeded) [REG, Annex III, 4.2.2]
[42] Dynamic test — definedAs — the test during which lifting machinery is operated in all its possible configurations (the test during which lifting machinery is operated in all its possible configurations) [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.1]
[43] guard coverage, wide-angle universal joints — requiresMeasure — at least to the centre of the outer joint or joints (at least to the centre of the outer joint or joints) [condition: in the case of wide-angle universal joints] [REG, Annex III, 3.4.7]
[44] warning and signalling devices — requiresMeasure — means to check that they are in good working order (means to check that they are in good working order) [condition: Where it is essential for safety] [DIR, Annex I, 3.6.1]
[45] loading control for machinery moved by power other than human strength — requiresMeasure — Loading control for machinery moved by power (loading control for machinery moved by power other than human strength) [condition: unless the manufacturer can demonstrate that there is no risk of overloading or overturning] [DIR, Annex I, 6.1.2]
[46] Lifting operation — definedAs — a movement of unit loads (a movement of unit loads) [REG, Annex III, 4.1]
[47] guard clearance for drive shaft — requiresMeasure — enough room to prevent the drive shaft damaging the guard (enough room to prevent the drive shaft damaging the guard) [condition: once it is in place] [REG, Annex III, 3.4.7]
[48] guards for moving transmission parts with frequent access — requiresMeasure — Interlocking movable guards (interlocking movable guards) [condition: where frequent access is envisaged] [DIR, Annex I, 1.3.8.1]
[49] manufacturer — hasObligation — perform appropriate tests, or have such tests performed (perform appropriate tests, or have such tests performed) [condition: In order to verify that the relevant parts of the machinery or related product comply with the requirements set out in sections 2.4.5.1 and 2.4.5.2, for each type of machinery or related product concerned] [REG, Annex III, 2.4.5.3]
